brief:
The Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem has launched the third edition of the "Don Tonino Bello" Award, the Patriarchate reported. The award focuses on peace in the world and peace in Jerusalem as its central theme, reflecting the legacy of Don Tonino Bello, a figure devoted to peace advocacy.

The ceremony is held at Alessano Cemetery, at the tomb of Don Tonino Bello. The award continues the tradition of honoring work and commitment toward building peace, with the Jerusalem component reflecting the Patriarchate's commitment to addressing peace in the region. The award represents an ongoing institutional effort to promote peacemaking through recognition of those who advance this cause.

title: Latin Patriarchate launches third edition of Don Tonino Bello peace award
